Madam/Sir, 
 
Update On Analyst Meet/Earnings Call: Audio Recording 
 
In continuation to our earlier intimation Ref. No. IRC/38/2026-27 dated 05.05.2026 and 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Clause 15 of Para A of Part A of Schedule III and 
Regulation 46(2)(o) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 as amended read with the guidance note of stock exchanges 
dated July 29, 2022 on disclosures pertaining to Investors meet, we wish to inform that 
the Bank has conducted an in person Analyst Meet/Earnings Call on Friday, May 8, 
2026 at 03:30 p.m. (IST) in Mumbai to discuss the financial performance of the Bank 
for the Quarter and Year ended March 31, 2026.  
 
The audio recording of aforementioned Analyst Meet/Earnings Call is uploaded on 
Bank’s website and same can be accessed through following link:  
 
https://www.iob.bank.in/documents/d/guest/q4fy26_analyst-meet_audio-
recording_08-05-2026 
 
This is for your information and appropriate dissemination. 
    
Yours faithfully, 
 
 
 
 
 
Raghuram Mallela 
Deputy General Manager/ 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
 
RAGHURAM 
MALLELA
